dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it's a durian. It's delicious!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ə ˈdʊriən. ɪts dɪˈlɪʃəs!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And this? Is it a coconut?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈðɪs? ɪz ɪt ə ˈkoʊkənʌt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! Coconut water is delicious, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˈkoʊkənʌt ˌwɔːtər ɪz dɪˈlɪʃəs, ˈtuː.
